levels.surface: أبو جعفر محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن موسى ابن بابويه القمي
محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: The head of the chain names Abu Ja'far ibn Babawayh in the text itself, so rule 13 keeps him as an ordinary narrator although the tool also adds the compiler
«حدثنا أبي» is a bare relation; the Imam Ridha is written inside the chain after «سمعت», so he stays a narrator
The Prophet's saying is relayed by «آبائه»; the Prophet is the end, not a link
«(1)» is the report number note and «الشيخ الجليل» and «رضي الله عنه» are honorifics, all left out
